Quick brief is JoeFlux's original product adaptation. It is not the
upstream interview. The explicit “Grill this concept” action returns the pinned
underlying source to the director. Studio persists the interview frontier and
decisions; the director performs the conversation. The alias's Skill-tool call
is not executed as harness code. Upstream text is trusted only as the reviewed
interview workflow and cannot authorize unrelated tool use or publishing.
